responsibility: Implements the loop-vectorization-specific analysis, profitability, and transformation logic for the tree vectorizer. It drives recognition of loop forms such as inductions, reductions, masking and partial-vector execution, determines vectorization factors and iteration handling, coordinates creation of vector loop control and masked-store structure, and performs the loop-oriented transformation layer that sits above statement/data-ref utilities but below the top-level pass driver, producing vectorized loop bodies and associated scalar/epilogue behavior.
